title: IH 10 at Highway 46

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located on the southwest corner of IH 10 West at Highway 46 in Boerne, Texas.

rows.label: Utilities
rows.text: All utilities are to the property line.
pairs: Provided by the City of Boerne
Provided by the City of Boerne
Provided by the City of Boerne
Provided by the City of Boerne
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: Federal Emergency Management Agency maps do not show any 100-year flood plain on the property.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: There are various utility easements on the property.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: Most recent (2024) Texas State Highway Department traffic count map indicates 49,557 vehicles per day on IH 10 north of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Potential Uses
rows.text: The I.H. 10 exposure, combined with Boerne residential growth and strong household income, creates development opportunities for a variety of commercial uses including, restaurants, banks, and a variety of neighborhood retail services.

comments: Tremendous visibility and access at the northern entrance to Boerne
The property is at a signalized intersection with excellent traffic exposure.
Area retailers include HEB, Home Depot, Whataburger, Chili’s and Starbuck’s.

No size line on the cover, so size_headline is empty. Spec Size 6.552 Acres matches Prismic size_label '6.552 acres' / acres 6.552 and the survey ('AREA: 6.552 ACRES (285,419 SQUARE FEET)').
Zoning: PDF 'C-4, Commercial, City of Boerne' vs Prismic 'C-4 Commercial, City of Boerne' (PDF has an extra comma after C-4; otherwise match).
